definitions.explanation: Distinctly different from others in a category; standing out as one of a kind. Used in both neutral-descriptive and scientific contexts to indicate something that deviates notably from the norm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{特異|とくい}な⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a person with a unique talent.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{特異|とくい}な⟦{生態系|せいたいけい}→生態系：04626_seitaikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A unique ecosystem spreads across this region.

examples.japanese: {特異|とくい}⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}する→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}→出る：00513_deru⟧やすい⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Due to their peculiar constitution, some patients are prone to side effects when taking this medication.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective ({特異|とくい}な) to describe people, phenomena, or things that are distinctly different. Common in academic, scientific, and medical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特異|とくい}な⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧ (unique talent)
- {特異|とくい}⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧ (peculiar constitution)
- {特異|とくい}{点|てん} (singular point — used in mathematics and science)
- {特異|とくい}な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧ (unique existence/being)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧: distinctive, characteristic (neutral, emphasizes individuality)
- ⟦{特殊|とくしゅ}→特殊：04566_tokushu⟧: special, specialized (implies requiring special handling or expertise)
- ⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧: good at, skilled in (same reading but different kanji and meaning)
